args.meaning: Optional front-door argv. Empty attempts retirement; --plan reports the proposed retirement path without renaming. It is not payload.dry-run.

changed.meaning: Whether the obsolete directory was found and a retirement path selected, even when only planning.

profiles.meaning: Sorted profile directory names observed after the attempted act or plan.

retiredPath.meaning: Timestamped retirement destination when the obsolete directory was found; null otherwise.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Unknown arguments are refused. An unhandled filesystem exception reaches the front-door exception path; a completed readback uses none.
